failed_hard_gates.evidence: At 288x384 thumbnail scale the adult face reads broadly and nearly frontally lit; an elevated off-axis key does not clearly model one near side.
At thumbnail and 1086x1448 native scale, the faint nose shading does not visibly connect into one continuous far-cheek shadow mass.
At thumbnail and native scale, light under the eyes spreads diffusely across the cheeks; no contained inverted light triangle with bounded edges survives beneath the far eye.
At native scale both eyes are readable, but the fill is flattened enough that there is no distinctly modeled shadow-side eye and surrounding face structure; the conjunctive gate therefore fails.
At native scale the face is carried by flat frontal beauty illumination with mild generic side shading, not by joined nose-cheek shadow geometry plus a far-cheek triangle.
